subject: ProdSentinel [CRITICAL] Several problems are hitting Line 5 at the same time
body:
Hello Anita,

You are responsible for this alert as Plant Manager.

Very urgent - act now: Several problems are hitting Line 5 at the same time

3 problems are expected on Line 5 at the same time: (1) The fill inspector may break down (pump or seal). (2) The palletizer may break down (pump or seal). (3) Label juice will run out. Each one could be handled alone, but together they put ₹13.0 lakh at risk.

How likely: Almost certain (99% chance)
About ₹13.0 lakh is at risk: ₹12.6 lakh of lost production and ₹45,094 of repair cost.

What you need to do:
  1. Hold a 15-minute call with the owners above to agree one plan for Line 5 (by Fri 16 Oct, 07:00)

Others involved:
  - Arjun Patel (Maintenance Lead): Replace the pump or seal on the palletizer (machine no. L5-PAL-01) during the next planned stop, before it breaks down
  - Sneha Kulkarni (Purchasing Manager): Call PrintPak Labels to speed up the Label juice delivery, or buy from an approved backup supplier

Please acknowledge alert ALR-00001 by Fri 16 Oct, 06:15. If it is not acknowledged, it will be escalated automatically.

subject: ProdSentinel [CRITICAL] Line 5 will run out of Label juice in about 2 days (Sun 18 Oct, 04:00)
body:
Hello Sneha,

You are responsible for this alert as Purchasing Manager.

Very urgent - act now: Line 5 will run out of Label juice in about 2 days (Sun 18 Oct, 04:00)

There is enough Label juice for about 1.9 days. The next delivery from PrintPak Labels is expected on Mon 19 Oct, 06:00 (the supplier has pushed it back from 17 Oct), which is too late: Line 5 would stand still for about 26 hours with no Label juice.

How likely: Almost certain (95% chance)
About ₹9.5 lakh is at risk: ₹9.5 lakh of lost production.

Why we think so:
  - We have 258,099 labels left and use about 5,516 labels every hour.

What you need to do:
  1. Call PrintPak Labels to speed up the Label juice delivery, or buy from an approved backup supplier (by Sat 17 Oct, 05:00)

Others involved:
  - Priya Menon (Line Supervisor): Change the Line 5 run plan to products that do not need Label juice until stock arrives

Please acknowledge alert ALR-00002 by Fri 16 Oct, 06:15. If it is not acknowledged, it will be escalated automatically.

subject: ProdSentinel [HIGH] The fill inspector on Line 4 may break down within 2 days
body:
Hello Arjun,

You are responsible for this alert as Maintenance Lead.

Urgent - act today: The fill inspector on Line 4 may break down within 2 days

The pump or seal on the fill inspector of Line 4 (Lemon soda 600 ml) is almost certain to fail in the next 2 days (98% chance). It has no backup, so the whole line would stop for about 4 hours while it is repaired. Machine number: L4-INS-01.

How likely: Almost certain (98% chance)
About ₹2.2 lakh is at risk: ₹1.9 lakh of lost production and ₹25,480 of repair cost.

Why we think so:
  - The machine raised 1 alarm in the last 24 hours (1 x position sensor fault).
  - Main warning signs: a long time since the pump or seal was last replaced.
  - Since yesterday the vibration has gone up and the drive speed has gone down.
  - The same thing happened before: on 12 Oct 2015 the fill inspector on Line 3 had 'pump cavitation noise; product leak at pump seal'. The cause was a pump or seal failure. It was fixed by: replaced mechanical seal (7 hours stopped).

What you need to do:
  1. Replace the pump or seal on the fill inspector (machine no. L4-INS-01) during the next planned stop, before it breaks down (by Fri 16 Oct, 18:00)
  2. Keep a spare pump or seal and a technician ready at the fill inspector (by Sat 17 Oct, 06:00)

Others involved:
  - Anita Rao (Plant Manager): If it cannot be fixed in time, move urgent orders from Line 4 to another line

Please acknowledge alert ALR-00003 by Fri 16 Oct, 06:30. If it is not acknowledged, it will be escalated automatically.

subject: ProdSentinel [HIGH] The conveyor on Line 3 may break down within 2 days
body:
Hello Arjun,

You are responsible for this alert as Maintenance Lead.

Urgent - act today: The conveyor on Line 3 may break down within 2 days

The bearing or gearbox on the conveyor of Line 3 (Cola 300 ml) is almost certain to fail in the next 2 days (98% chance). It has no backup, so the whole line would stop for about 4 hours while it is repaired. Machine number: L3-CNV-04.

How likely: Almost certain (98% chance)
About ₹1.7 lakh is at risk: ₹1.6 lakh of lost production and ₹17,640 of repair cost.

Why we think so:
  - The machine raised 2 alarms in the last 24 hours (1 x motor over-temperature, 1 x air pressure fluctuation).
  - Main warning signs: a long time since the bearing or gearbox was last replaced and average drive speed over the last 24 hours.
  - Since yesterday the drive speed has gone down and the pneumatic pressure has gone up.
  - The same thing happened before: on 15 Oct 2015 the conveyor on Line 5 had 'bearing housing hot to touch; oil seepage at gearbox'. The cause was a bearing or gearbox failure. It was fixed by: realigned coupling and replaced bearing (5 hours stopped).

What you need to do:
  1. Replace the bearing or gearbox on the conveyor (machine no. L3-CNV-04) during the next planned stop, before it breaks down (by Fri 16 Oct, 18:00)

subject: ProdSentinel [MEDIUM] The blow molder on Line 1 may break down within 2 days
body:
Hello Arjun,

You are responsible for this alert as Maintenance Lead.

Important - plan a fix: The blow molder on Line 1 may break down within 2 days

The bearing or gearbox on the blow molder of Line 1 (Packaged water 500 ml) is almost certain to fail in the next 2 days (98% chance). The line would slow down to about 50% speed for about 4 hours while it is repaired. Machine number: L1-BLW-01.

How likely: Almost certain (98% chance)
About ₹64,060 is at risk: ₹46,420 of lost production and ₹17,640 of repair cost.

Why we think so:
  - The machine raised 3 alarms in the last 24 hours (2 x air pressure fluctuation, 1 x motor over-temperature).
  - Main warning signs: average drive speed over the last 24 hours and a long time since the bearing or gearbox was last replaced.
  - Since yesterday the drive speed has gone down and the motor supply voltage has gone up.
  - The same thing happened before: on 14 Oct 2015 the blow molder on Line 5 had 'vibration rising over last shifts; grinding noise from gearbox'. The cause was a bearing or gearbox failure. It was fixed by: replaced gearbox (4 hours stopped).

What you need to do:
  1. Replace the bearing or gearbox on the blow molder (machine no. L1-BLW-01) during the next planned stop, before it breaks down (by Fri 16 Oct, 18:00)
